description: A proposed edit to the collective note for a session. The diff content blob is stored on the Ring; this PDS record holds metadata and status. Accepted or rejected by the Class Rep.

sessionUri.description: AT URI of the app.changala.session whose collective note this proposal targets.

diffRingRef.description: Reference to the diff blob on the Ring.

summary.description: Short description of the proposed change.

resolvedAt.description: Timestamp when the proposal was accepted or rejected.

resolvedBy.description: DID of the Class Rep who resolved this proposal.
